excluded_occurrences.reason: RFC 2119/8174 keyword-definition text, not a protocol requirement.
RFC 2119/8174 keyword-definition text, not a protocol requirement.

requirements.requirement: Optional inference profiles do not change the meaning of Core declarations.
requirements.verification: Review each profile specification for semantic overrides of Core fields or declarations.

requirements.requirement: A conforming implementation preserves all ten architecture invariants.
requirements.verification: Current tests cover nominal identity, declaration/implementation separation, visible state, hard identity, explicit routing, and provenance; multiple representations, standards reuse, and independent non-Kalo implementation remain unproven.

requirements.requirement: Every Core descriptor contains the spec and kind envelope fields.
requirements.verification: Validate every canonical descriptor kind against its schema and load the complete canonical catalog.

requirements.requirement: Descriptor map keys are strings in the JSON data model.
requirements.verification: Add YAML fixtures with non-string map keys and require consumers and publishers to reject them.

requirements.requirement: Publishers do not assign semantics to map ordering, YAML tags, anchors or aliases, duplicate keys, comments, or non-JSON scalar types.
requirements.verification: Inspect publisher serialization and round-trip behavior; the draft suite has no Publisher claim gate.

requirements.requirement: Namespace, name, and binding tokens use uppercase ASCII.
requirements.verification: Run every canonical address vector through the implementation parser.

requirements.requirement: Namespace, name, and binding tokens start with A-Z and contain only A-Z, digits, or hyphen thereafter.
requirements.verification: Accept valid token vectors and reject invalid token starts and characters.

requirements.requirement: A version starts with a digit and then contains only ASCII letters, digits, dot, or hyphen.
requirements.verification: Accept valid version vectors and reject resource or binding versions that do not start with a digit.

requirements.requirement: Address comparison does not apply percent encoding, URL normalization, Unicode normalization, or case folding.
requirements.verification: Percent-encoded, URL-shaped, and case-invalid inputs are rejected; explicit Unicode-normalization vectors are still missing.

requirements.requirement: A symbolic address is not the sole source of hard identity.
requirements.verification: Reject conflicting immutable resource and Namespace identities behind symbolic names.

requirements.requirement: A resolver rejects results whose namespace, family, or version identity does not satisfy requester constraints.
requirements.verification: Current cases exercise missing bindings and conflicting Contract/Namespace identity; explicit family-ID and all resource-kind mismatch vectors remain missing.

requirements.requirement: Published Contract, Processor, and Representation Binding versions are immutable.
requirements.verification: The suite rejects a mutated Contract Version; equivalent Processor and Representation Binding mutation cases are still missing.

requirements.requirement: A publisher does not silently retarget a symbolic address to a semantically different immutable version.
requirements.verification: Define Publisher fixtures that publish, attempt retargeting, and verify rejection plus new-version behavior.

requirements.requirement: An external descriptor-digest record makes the serialized form or media type explicit.
requirements.verification: Inspect each catalog, manifest, or publication format that records descriptor-byte digests.

requirements.requirement: Every ProcessorImplementation descriptor digests its executable artifact.
requirements.verification: Require the digest field, resolve the implementation, and reject exact-byte digest mismatch.

requirements.requirement: A resolver surfaces an ambiguous Namespace alias rather than choosing an authority silently.
requirements.verification: Load conflicting immutable identities for one alias and require explicit rejection.

requirements.requirement: A Contract descriptor contains address, namespace_id, family_id, version_id, version, and a normative definition body or reference.
requirements.verification: Validate the Contract schema and every canonical Contract instance.

requirements.requirement: A Contract version field equals the version token in its address.
requirements.verification: Parse each Contract address and compare its version token to the descriptor version field.

requirements.requirement: Every version in a Contract Family retains the same namespace_id and family_id.
requirements.verification: Add a multi-version Contract Family fixture with valid and conflicting namespace/family identities.

requirements.requirement: Each immutable Contract version has a distinct version_id.
requirements.verification: Add multi-version fixtures that reuse a version_id and require explicit rejection.

requirements.requirement: A Representation Binding identifies its address, parent Contract and version identity, binding name and version, immutable binding identity, and representation.
requirements.verification: Validate the binding schema and canonical instances, then reject unresolved required bindings.

requirements.requirement: SPEC does not duplicate features adequately defined by external representation standards.
requirements.verification: Review each proposed Core representation feature against existing standards before acceptance.

requirements.requirement: A Composer does not invent implicit conversion from structural compatibility alone.
requirements.verification: Present same-shaped but nominally distinct Contracts and require composition rejection without an explicit edge or relation.

requirements.requirement: Contract dependencies are explicit symbolic references.
requirements.verification: Add dependency-bearing valid, unresolved, malformed, and cyclic catalogs and define class-specific expectations.

requirements.requirement: Extends, specializes, supersedes, and derived-from relations do not alone authorize substitution.
requirements.verification: Add one negative composition case per descriptive relation and require rejection without an adapting Processor or compatibility relation.

requirements.requirement: A Processor descriptor declares both inputs and outputs lists.
requirements.verification: Validate the required Processor fields and canonical Processor declarations.

requirements.requirement: At least one of a Processor's inputs or outputs lists is non-empty.
requirements.verification: Add a Processor with both lists empty and require implementation rejection; schema expression alone is not implementation evidence.

requirements.requirement: Material state dependencies are visible at the Processor boundary.
requirements.verification: The host fail-closed behavior is tested; an assessor must inspect implementations for material but undeclared state dependencies.

requirements.requirement: For every proposed edge, a Composer verifies semantic identity or authorization, binding compatibility, State Ports, effects, implementation constraints, and absence of contradicted constraints.
requirements.verification: Individual negative gates are exercised, but the draft suite has no Composer claim and lacks a systematic matrix for every relation, capability, trust, and locality combination.

requirements.requirement: Structural similarity alone does not satisfy semantic identity or binding compatibility.
requirements.verification: Require explicit nominal boundaries despite structural similarity.

requirements.requirement: Unknown compatibility, state, effect, or implementation information is not treated as compatible.
requirements.verification: Exercise fail-closed negative cases across each declared compatibility gate.

requirements.requirement: A Receipt identifies the receipt and its Processor or Composition subject.
requirements.verification: Validate every emitted stage and composition Receipt against the canonical schema and selected route.

requirements.requirement: A Receipt records input and output semantic identities.
requirements.verification: Compare Receipt Contract and binding identities and byte digests with every executed boundary artifact.

requirements.requirement: An implementation rejects a descriptor whose Core version it cannot process safely.
requirements.verification: Add unsupported and future Core-version descriptors and require explicit rejection before resolution or execution.

requirements.requirement: An implementation does not claim a conformance class whose required behavior it lacks.
requirements.verification: The report verifier rejects claims with non-passing required tests and claims for uncovered classes.

requirements.requirement: An unknown required extension produces explicit incompatibility.
requirements.verification: Inject an unknown required extension and require explicit descriptor incompatibility.

requirements.requirement: A resource with an unknown required extension is not executed or republished as fully understood.
requirements.verification: Validation blocks the resource before execution; Publisher and republishing behavior are not covered.

requirements.requirement: Extensions do not redefine Core fields or weaken Core security and identity requirements.
requirements.verification: Review extension specifications and implementation handling for shadowed Core fields or weakened checks.

requirements.requirement: Implementations account for the ten enumerated spoofing, code, substitution, registry, staleness, Receipt, effect, digest, and denial-of-service threats.
requirements.verification: Use an assessor security checklist for every enumerated threat; existing tests support only alias, substitution, digest, effect, and Receipt-link portions.

requirements.requirement: A Receipt consumer does not treat an unsigned Receipt as inherently trusted.
requirements.verification: Inspect trust decisions and add a future unsigned-Receipt policy fixture when Receipt-consumer conformance is defined.

requirements.requirement: SPEC does not duplicate WIT's executable interface and ABI model.
requirements.verification: Review proposed Core executable-interface additions against WIT before acceptance.
